# Professions

Gathering professions take materials from nodes in the fields; making professions turn them into items.

Professions go up to level 99. Ranks: Novice (1), Apprentice (20), Journeyman (40), Expert (60), Master (80).

| Profession | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Gathering](../professions/gathering.md) | Gathering | General gathering: fibre from hay bales and ferns, wood from fallen logs. |
| [Herbalism](../professions/herbalism.md) | Gathering | Plants and herbs. |
| [Mining](../professions/mining.md) | Gathering | Minerals and ores, struck from the veins in the fields. |
| [Cooking](../professions/cooking.md) | Making | Food recipes. |
| [Alchemy](../professions/alchemy.md) | Making | Potions and alchemical recipes. |
| [Scrollcrafting](../professions/scrollcrafting.md) | Making | Upgrade scrolls and return scrolls. |
| [Tailoring](../professions/tailoring.md) | Making | Cloth armour, capes and materials. |
| [Smithing](../professions/smithing.md) | Making | Ingots, weapons and plate, worked from the ore Mining brings. |
